toolchain.generated_configuration: LLVM O3; generic CPU; PIC; checked arithmetic; explicit roots; x64 loop alignment 64 bytes

implementation: Mark closed AOT bounded scalar leaf calls for the existing bounded-poll optimizer
Recognize ready edges from request/recovery state metadata instead of assuming branch successor order
Analyze only normal loop paths while retaining slow observable paths and all error exits
Run bounded-loop analysis after inlining and before loop rotation, recognizing LLVM same-sign comparisons
Keep the existing late integer optimization stage and align x64 offline loops to 64-byte instruction cache lines
Retain checked increment, checked accumulation, array bounds, failure prefixes and exact logical depth limits

measurement.aggregation: Median and sample CV from all nine samples; no outlier filtering or wrapper subtraction

suite.description: AOT calls plus three arithmetic sizes and host controls, each paired with unchanged C++ kernels

comparison.reason: The previous entry retains a broader 66-case suite; this entry measures ten identical cases in matched before/after processes

before.aot_codegen: LLVM O3; generic CPU; PIC; checked arithmetic; explicit roots

after.jit_optimized: LLVM O3; host CPU; typed slots; SCC direct calls/inlining; body dependencies; selective recovery

prior_full_regression.scope: Pure-call loop changes before the final pass split and x64 loop-alignment adjustment

semantic_coverage: Overflow in the leaf and accumulation, short-array bounds, zero length and failure prefixes after chunk boundaries
Callee/caller failure trace and exact depth budget including empty and 4096-iteration loops
Both branch orientations, tagged control-state proofs, rejection of observable loop calls
Signed and proven same-sign comparisons; unknown unsigned/wrapping steps are not assumed bounded
